lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: We need to talk about what happens next.
lines.lens: Five people around a fire. Each one processing at a different speed. Suri already has numbers. Lex already has history. Rynn already has a map.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: The Solenné grain exchange is gone. Not struggling — gone. Three more weeks and the coastal villages start rationing. Six weeks after that, it stops being about money.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: I mapped what's left of the northern route. It's still passable if you go through the Ereivyn canopy, but the canopy is thinning. Things grow wrong near the distortion.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: The archive records show this happened before. Three hundred and forty years ago. Same pattern. Same progression. The records end because the people writing them stopped existing.
lines.monologue: He said it carefully. Not for drama. Because he wanted to be precise about the weight of it.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: The threshold is getting thinner. I can feel it when I close my eyes now. I couldn't before.
lines.monologue: He's not afraid. That's the part that's hard to understand. He's not afraid of it the way the rest of us are.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: So what are we calculating here? The cost of going toward it, or the cost of not?
lines.monologue: She asked it like a trade evaluation. What's the margin. What's the risk. What's the loss if we walk away.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: I've packed for three days of hard travel. Four if we ration. The route back to Naevoria is still clear but it won't be for long.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: They're all looking at me. Not because I have an answer. Because I'm the one who starts walking.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zi stands and begins checking her pack.

choices.text: We go back to the ruins.
I'm not sure this is something we can fix.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: I'll bring the archive notes. Whatever we find, someone should write it down this time.
lines.monologue: His hands were steady. That surprised her.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: I'll handle supplies. Three days of hard travel, you said?
lines.monologue: She was already counting. She counts when she's scared. It helps.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: You're right that we might not be able to fix it. But I think I'm supposed to be there when it happens.
lines.monologue: He said 'supposed to' like someone remembering the shape of a word they'd forgotten.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: Not because she believed him. Because she believed he needed to be there, and she wasn't going to let him go alone.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: First light. I'll have the packs ready.
